Alex Chen: Quick sync — Orbit Alliance listing + webinar execution. Need to lock on: marketplace listing timeline, webinar date/time, landing page copy, and inbound lead routing. TL;DR: submit Orbit listing Thurs, webinar Wed 4/12, co-blog week after. Who takes what? :spiral_calendar:
Priya Patel: Love it. Can we pick an APAC-friendly webinar time (late morning PST / early evening APAC)? Also need co-branded hero creative. @Kara can you own partner comms? :art:
Mateo Rivera: I can own the landing page + registration form. Propose utm_source=orbit_alliance for tracking. Will drop embed snippet here.
Jenna Liu: I’ll draft the benchmark narrative for the joint blog — need perf & cost numbers from eng. @Mateo can you surface token-costs and p95 latencies?
Sean Ortiz: For inbound routing — recommend webhook to /integrations/orbit and auto-assign to sales-sd queue. Also want lead-level utm fields mapped to SFDC. @Alex any SLAs for handoff?
Kara Singh: On it. I’ll request Orbit’s co-marketing checklist and logo assets. I’ll also confirm their newsletter slot availability.
listing-bot: :robot_face: Reminder — Orbit marketplace submission requires: privacy_policy_url, support_email, screenshots (900x600). Missing: privacy_policy.
Alex Chen: Good catch. Mateo please add a privacy_policy link on the landing. Action items: Mateo (landing + utm + privacy link), Jenna (blog outline + ask list), Priya (creative + webinar ops), Kara (partner ops + listing), Sean (routing + paid test). I’ll create the calendar invites and a master doc.
Priya Patel: Can we allocate $1k for a small paid boost the week before? LinkedIn or sponsored newsletter with Orbit audience. @Sean?
Sean Ortiz: Approved $1k. I’ll run a small LinkedIn lead gen and share targeting later.
Mateo Rivera: Embed snippet for registration form:

Mateo Rivera: Also added privacy policy: https://redwood.com/privacy — ping if legal wants different copy.
Jenna Liu: Blog outline posted in the project doc: 1) ecosystem problem 2) Redwood + Orbit integration story 3) benchmark + cost analysis 4) how-to + CTA. Draft by Tue EOD.
Kara Singh: Orbit comms confirmed a newsletter blurb on Mon 4/11 and partner co-author for the blog. They need final hero by Fri.
Alex Chen: Perfect. I’ll update master doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/orbit-alliance-ecosystem and open Jira epic MK-4782 with tasks for each owner. Please update the epic when you have drafts.
Priya Patel: I’ll share creative variants (1 hero, 2 social cards) by Thu.
Sean Ortiz: I’ll share the lead mapping spreadsheet once webhook is ready. Quick ask: include original_referrer in payload.
Alex Chen: Nice. Target to finalize everything by EOD Fri so Orbit can approve listing next week. Thanks y’all! :tada:
